dlive.sx.name: dlive.sx
dlive.sx.note: DaddyLiveHD 24/7 channel index. The page lists channels as HTML player pages (/stream/stream-<id>.php) whose stream address is resolved by JavaScript at run time, and its channels/schedule API needs a key issued by the operator, so the site publishes no static playlist. The catalogue is counted for visibility only and no channel is imported. Set DLIVE_M3U_URL to an authorized direct playlist URL - for example one generated by a self-hosted proxy - to import it and have every link checked like any other source.

Easy-Web-TV-M3u8.name: Easy-Web-TV-M3u8
Easy-Web-TV-M3u8.note: zhangboheng's all-in-one web TV catalogue. Its country pages are generated in the browser from the iptv-org public API (which this repository already reads through the iptv-org source), and the repository tree publishes no .m3u file at all, so there is nothing to import. This check counts the playlists it carries so a future static export is noticed.

iptvcat.name: iptvcat
iptvcat.note: IPTV Cat's US catalogue (1,621 channels, 1,593 online on 2026-11-24; 14,018 worldwide). Each row offers only a single-channel wrapper playlist (list.iptvcat.net/my_list/s/<hash>.m3u8 around the real stream URL) and the bulk 'Download this list' action is built in the browser from a session list, so the site publishes no single static M3U the scraper can fetch and link-check as a source. Sampled wrapper URLs (e.g. the 30A TV feeds) are already in the published corpus, and the catalogue is smaller than the current lineup in both the US (1,621 vs ~2,900) and worldwide (14,018 vs 19,621). Checked for reachability only and never imported as channels; see docs/SOURCE-HUNT-2026-11-24.md. If IPTV Cat ever publishes a static bulk M3U, add it as a source and let the daily link check decide what survives.

gradetv.name: gradetv
gradetv.note: Grade TV (iptv-org Providers discussion #769) is a browser catalogue and M3U exporter over the iptv-org channel data - its ids are iptv-org ids such as 00sReplay.us and 3ABNEnglish.us - so it duplicates the iptv-org source already configured. Checked for reachability only and never imported.

broadcast-atlas.name: broadcast-atlas
broadcast-atlas.note: Broadcast Atlas (iptv-org Providers discussion #845) is a directory and player built on iptv-org's channel data, with each channel keeping its iptv-org identifier; it publishes no playlist of its own, so importing it would only re-fetch the iptv-org source. Checked for reachability only and never imported as channels.

open-tv-atlas.name: open-tv-atlas
open-tv-atlas.note: Open TV Atlas (iptv-org Providers discussion #968) generates M3U URLs by combining iptv-org language, category and quality slices, so every link it can produce already arrives through the configured iptv-org source. Checked for reachability only and never imported as channels.
